title: External-Review Step-Verifier Result
description: The payload the general-purpose step-verifier returns after independently re-deriving a phase's acceptance criteria in the external-review pattern. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains ONLY; the verification SEMANTICS (re-derive ground truth, do not trust the orchestrator, the phase gate loop) live in flow-external-review. Return ONLY an object conforming to this schema.

pass.description: Whether every acceptance criterion for the phase was independently verified as met.

failures.description: One entry per unmet criterion. Empty when pass is true.

detail.description: What was found instead — the evidence of the failure.

fix_hint.description: What the orchestrator should remediate to satisfy the criterion.

confidence.description: The verifier's stated confidence in the result. Same value domain as the arbiter/advocate confidence field, for cross-contract consistency.
